artifacts.notes: Normalized transcription, not a facsimile or critical edition. Historical Latin wording is public domain in the United States; portal markup and translations have separate rights. Historical witness: Acta Apostolicae Sedis 1 (1909), pp. 725–738. Uncollated normalized web transcription; source wording and numbering retained apart from the explicitly recorded corrections and apparatus exclusions. Dated 4 October 1909, unlike catalog index date. The act ends on page 738; page 739 begins another act. Historical reference notes retained. The official indexes give conflicting act dates. The reviewed act date is 1909-10-04, identified at https://www.vatican.va/archive/aas/documents/AAS-01-1909-ocr.pdf printed pp. 725–738; dating clause p. 738.
artifacts.rights_basis: Historical Latin wording identified in Acta Apostolicae Sedis 1 (1909), pp. 725–738, published by 1930. United States expired-term assessment under 17 U.S.C. 304/305; qualifying foreign restoration under 104A(a)(1)(B) only receives the remaining term. Under 103(b), this covers preexisting historical wording rather than modern creative additions. Vatican HTML, translations of later date, and scan/reprint wrappers have separate rights. See src/sources/inventories/papal-documents-rights-v1.toml.
